spec2def(sfcfiles.dll sfcfiles.spec)

# sfcfiles.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sfcfiles-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(sfcfiles_shims OBJECT sfcfiles.c)
target_link_libraries(sfcfiles_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(sfcfiles sfcfiles-cargo sfcfiles.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS sfcfiles_shims)
